title: DFM for sheet metal
description: Rules for a laser-cut and press-brake-bent part built with base_flange/edge_flange: bend radius, flange length, material around holes.

thickness.description: Sheet thickness (mm); a design param such as "$t" also works.

min_bend_ratio.description: Inner bend radius / thickness: 1.0 mild steel and soft aluminium, more for hard alloys.

min_flange_ratio.description: Shortest flange as a multiple of the thickness.

min_hole_web_ratio.description: Material between a hole and the nearest edge as a multiple of the thickness.

rules.citation: Guideline: inner bend radius of at least 1 x thickness for mild steel; minimum bending radii for steel sheet are tabulated in DIN 6935
Guideline: press-brake tooling needs a flange of about 4 x thickness to support the sheet across the die
Guideline: keep at least 2 x thickness between a cut hole and the nearest edge to avoid bulging
ISO 2768-1:1989, Table 1 (permissible deviations for linear dimensions); process capability per DUCAD guideline
